bill.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Evaluation Act of 2025

action.description: Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs. Hearings held.

posted_text:
🧠 US S 2938 — Congress Wants to Test AI Risks – Here’s What Changes

Congress is setting up a program to evaluate the risks posed by advanced artificial intelligence. This bill requires companies developing ‘advanced AI systems’ – defined as those using more than 1026 calculations – to participate in this program. Developers must share their code, training data, and system parameters with the Energy Secretary. ...
